title: Responsibility Perspective Transfer for Italian Femicide News
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The task is 'Responsibility Perspective Transfer', which involves rewriting descriptions of gender-based violence to alter the perceived level of responsibility on the perpetrator.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its findings are focused on the ability of models like mBART and GPT-3 to rewrite sentences about femicide to increase the perceived responsibility of the perpetrator, with GPT-3 (iter-1 setup) performing best overall.
